title: A carbonyl at the end
hook: Inspect the bonds and identify the functional group.

knows: Lines in a structural formula represent chemical bonds.
doesNotKnow: An aldehyde contains a terminal carbonyl carbon bonded to hydrogen. Ethanal has the illustrated –C(=O)H group.

misconception: Every molecule with the same element contains the same functional group.
objective: Recognize the stated functional group from condensed structural connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structure and explanation: Which listed functional group best describes the distinctive group in this condensed structural diagram? This diagram represents ethanal. An aldehyde contains a terminal carbonyl carbon bonded to hydrogen. Ethanal has the illustrated –C(=O)H group. Lines show bonds; grouped labels such as CH₃ are condensed notation.
The diagram is a condensed 2D structural representation, not a model of molecular geometry.
Recall: Which group is illustrated in the ethanal example? An aldehyde contains a terminal carbonyl carbon bonded to hydrogen. Ethanal has the illustrated –C(=O)H group.
